title: 宝塚記念の後に・なんとでっけえ雷鳴よ

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Inari One bursts through, taking the lead! And she's keeping it! Inari One crosses the finish!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Hehe, that was a doozy… I nabbed the win, but I pushed myself way over the limit!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Damn it… Guess you got me there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's my loss today. Truth is, I underestimated ya. And I have the burns to prove it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehe… I barely broke a sweat!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I'm only lettin' ya off the hook this once.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll be the one to win next time. And don'tcha forget it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Heh. Already has her sights on our next race, eh? She's got a style all her own, I'll give her that!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (She's proud and loud. I may have won, but I let my guard down for sure.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I needa learn from this. The centrals are no joke… and the same goes for Tama!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That settles it… I'll win this race next year too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: From today, Hanshin's gonna see some real style!
